title: ACAP message envelope
description: Every ACAP WebSocket message is one JSON object matching this envelope. The `data` payload is validated by the per-type schema selected by `type`.

v.description: Envelope/wire major version. MUST be 1 for ACAP 1.0.

type.description: Message type; selects the payload schema. Receivers MUST ignore unknown types.

id.description: agentId the message concerns (source agentId for adapter→server, target agentId for server→adapter). Optional only for connection-scoped frames (ping/pong/hello).

ts.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 UTC timestamp, millisecond precision.

data.description: Type-specific payload. Validated by the matching schema in this directory.
